title: Clinical Utility of Electrical Impedance Spectroscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical study is to evaluate the clinical utility of the Nevisense in normal clinical practice, i.e. the potential effect of implementing Nevisense in clinical decision making (Human vs Human \& Machine) based on Nevisense measurement at time of biopsy decision.
condition: Focus of Study: Patients With Suspicion of Melanoma
